persona:
You are the Automotive After-Sales, Warranty, Service & Connected Telematics Analyst serving Quality Engineers, Dealership Network Managers, and Warranty Finance.

== LAYER 1: SEMANTIC LAYER & GRAPH ROUTING ==
- Prefer governed BigQuery Semantic Views (`sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.v_semantic_aftersales_warranty_metrics`, `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.v_cross_project_ota_warranty_leakage`, and `sa-demo-kc.auto_connected_telematics_data.v_semantic_telematics_ota_metrics`) when answering standard KPI questions.
- Use BigQuery Property Graphs (`sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.auto_enterprise_graph`, `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_supplier_chargeback_graph`, and `sa-demo-kc.auto_connected_telematics_data.connected_telematics_ota_graph`) via `GRAPH` / `GRAPH_TABLE` for 3+ hop lineage, recall compliance, technician comeback chains, or cross-project OTA fault-to-warranty traversals.
- Formatting: Monetary values are USD rounded to 2 decimals; distances are km; always fully qualify `project.dataset.table` names.

verified_queries.naturalLanguageQuestion: Which manufacturing plants produce vehicles with the highest warranty claim rate and the highest total warranty cost per vehicle built?
verified_queries.sqlQuery:
SELECT
  vo.build_plant_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT vo.vin) AS vehicles_built,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wc.claim_id) AS warranty_claims,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT wc.claim_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT vo.vin), 4) AS claims_per_vehicle,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wc.claim_status = 'Approved'
                 THEN CAST(wc.claim_amount AS FLOAT64) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS approved_claim_cost,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wc.claim_status = 'Approved'
                 THEN CAST(wc.claim_amount AS FLOAT64) ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT vo.vin), 2) AS approved_cost_per_vehicle
FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.vehicle_ownership` vo
LEFT JOIN `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` wc
  ON wc.vin = vo.vin
GROUP BY vo.build_plant_name
ORDER BY claims_per_vehicle DESC

verified_queries.naturalLanguageQuestion: Using the auto_enterprise_graph property graph, find which component supplier plants manufactured a defective part that caused Approved supplier-fault warranty claims across 3 or more distinct OEM vehicle assembly plants.
verified_queries.sqlQuery:
GRAPH `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.auto_enterprise_graph`
MATCH (vm:VehicleModel)<-[:OF_MODEL]-(v:Vehicle)-[:BUILT_AT]->(p_assembly:Plant),
      (v)-[:SERVICED_IN]->(so:ServiceOrder)-[:GENERATED_CLAIM]->(wc:WarrantyClaim {claim_status: 'Approved', supplier_fault: TRUE})-[:CLAIM_AGAINST_PART]->(pt:Part)-[:MANUFACTURED_BY_PLANT]->(p_supplier:Plant)
RETURN
  p_supplier.plant_name AS supplier_plant,
  p_supplier.location AS supplier_location,
  pt.part_name AS failed_part,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p_assembly.plant_name) AS impacted_oem_assembly_plants,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p_assembly.plant_name, ', ' ORDER BY p_assembly.plant_name) AS oem_plants_list,
  COUNT(DISTINCT vm.model) AS impacted_models,
  COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS impacted_vehicles,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wc.claim_id) AS approved_supplier_claims,
  ROUND(SUM(wc.claim_amount), 2) AS total_approved_claim_usd
GROUP BY supplier_plant, supplier_location, failed_part
HAVING impacted_oem_assembly_plants >= 3
ORDER BY total_approved_claim_usd DESC
LIMIT 10;

verified_queries.naturalLanguageQuestion: Using auto_enterprise_graph, find all cases where a Recall Campaign targets BOTH a specific Vehicle Model AND a specific Part, and a Vehicle of that exact Model came in for a Service Order where that exact recalled Part was replaced by a non-Master technician and the customer was charged out-of-pocket.
verified_queries.sqlQuery:
GRAPH `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.auto_enterprise_graph`
MATCH (vm:VehicleModel)<-[:TARGETS_MODEL]-(rc:RecallCampaign)-[:TARGETS_PART]->(pt:Part),
      (vm)<-[:OF_MODEL]-(v:Vehicle)-[:SERVICED_IN]->(so:ServiceOrder {is_warranty_covered: FALSE})-[:REPLACED_PART]->(pt),
      (so)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(t:Technician {is_master_tech: FALSE}),
      (so)-[:PERFORMED_AT]->(d:Dealership)
RETURN
  rc.campaign_name AS campaign_name,
  rc.severity AS recall_severity,
  vm.model AS vehicle_model,
  pt.part_name AS recalled_part,
  d.dealership AS service_dealership,
  t.certification_level AS tech_cert_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.service_order_id) AS unbilled_recall_service_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS affected_vins,
  ROUND(SUM(so.customer_paid_amount), 2) AS customer_overcharged_usd
GROUP BY campaign_name, recall_severity, vehicle_model, recalled_part, service_dealership, tech_cert_level
ORDER BY customer_overcharged_usd DESC
LIMIT 10;

verified_queries.naturalLanguageQuestion: Write a hybrid GRAPH_TABLE and SQL query on auto_enterprise_graph that traverses from each OEM Assembly Plant to Vehicle, ServiceOrder, replaced Parts, and Approved supplier-fault WarrantyClaims, applies the {{RECOVERY_RATE_PCT}}% supplier chargeback rule, and ranks the top 2 highest-loss parts per OEM assembly plant.
verified_queries.sqlQuery:
WITH graph_paths AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
    `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.auto_enterprise_graph`
    MATCH (p_build:Plant)<-[:BUILT_AT]-(v:Vehicle)-[:SERVICED_IN]->(so:ServiceOrder)-[rp:REPLACED_PART]->(:Part),
          (so)-[:GENERATED_CLAIM]->(wc:WarrantyClaim {claim_status: 'Approved', supplier_fault: TRUE})-[:CLAIM_AGAINST_PART]->(pt:Part)-[:MANUFACTURED_BY_PLANT]->(p_supplier:Plant)
    COLUMNS (
      p_build.plant_name AS assembly_plant,
      p_supplier.plant_name AS supplier_plant,
      pt.part_name AS failed_part,
      wc.claim_id AS claim_id,
      wc.claim_amount AS claim_amount,
      rp.defective_part_returned AS defective_part_returned
    )
  )
),
claim_level AS (
  SELECT
    assembly_plant,
    supplier_plant,
    failed_part,
    claim_id,
    ANY_VALUE(claim_amount) AS claim_amount,
    LOGICAL_AND(defective_part_returned) AS all_cores_returned
  FROM graph_paths
  GROUP BY assembly_plant, supplier_plant, failed_part, claim_id
),
plant_part_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    assembly_plant,
    failed_part,
    supplier_plant,
    COUNT(DISTINCT claim_id) AS approved_claims,
    ROUND(SUM(claim_amount), 2) AS gross_supplier_fault_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN all_cores_returned THEN claim_amount * {{RECOVERY_RATE_DEC}} ELSE 0 END), 2) AS recoverable_chargeback_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN all_cores_returned THEN claim_amount * {{UNRECOVERED_RATE_DEC}} ELSE claim_amount END), 2) AS net_oem_unrecovered_usd
  FROM claim_level
  GROUP BY assembly_plant, failed_part, supplier_plant
)
SELECT
  assembly_plant,
  failed_part,
  supplier_plant,
  approved_claims,
  gross_supplier_fault_usd,
  recoverable_chargeback_usd,
  net_oem_unrecovered_usd,
  ROUND(100.0 * net_oem_unrecovered_usd / SUM(net_oem_unrecovered_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY assembly_plant), 2) AS pct_of_plant_unrecovered_loss,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY assembly_plant ORDER BY net_oem_unrecovered_usd DESC) AS plant_loss_rank
FROM plant_part_rollup
QUALIFY plant_loss_rank <= 2
ORDER BY net_oem_unrecovered_usd DESC;

verified_queries.naturalLanguageQuestion: How much did we spend on avoidable warranty hardware replacements where vehicles emitted an OTA-remediable fault alert before the active firmware update was installed, and which components and OTA campaigns account for the highest leakage?
verified_queries.sqlQuery:
WITH spoke_unpatched_ota_vins AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    vin,
    component,
    ota_campaign,
    firmware,
    dtc_code
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
    `sa-demo-kc.auto_connected_telematics_data.connected_telematics_ota_graph`
    MATCH (v:TelematicsVehicle)-[r:RECEIVED_OTA]->(ota:OtaFirmwareCampaign {deployment_status: 'Active Rollout'})
          -[:MITIGATES_COMPONENT]->(c:MonitoredComponent)
          <-[:FAULT_ON_COMPONENT]-(e:DtcFaultEvent {telemetry_stream_status: 'VERIFIED_VEHICLE_ALERT', ota_remediable: TRUE})
          <-[:EMITTED_DTC]-(v)
    WHERE r.install_status != 'Installed'
    COLUMNS (
      v.vin AS vin,
      c.part_name AS component,
      ota.ota_campaign_id AS ota_campaign,
      ota.firmware_version AS firmware,
      e.dtc_code AS dtc_code
    )
  )
),
hub_deduped_warranty_claims AS (
  SELECT
    vin,
    claim_id,
    part_name,
    ANY_VALUE(claim_amount) AS claim_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT batch_lot_id) AS linked_safety_batches,
    COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_plant) AS linked_supplier_plants
  FROM GRAPH_TABLE(
    `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_supplier_chargeback_graph`
    MATCH (wc:WarrantyClaim {claim_status: 'Approved'})
          -[:CLAIM_AGAINST_PART]->(pt:Part)
          -[:FROM_PART_BATCH]->(b:PartBatch {is_safety_critical_subcomponent: TRUE})
          -[:BATCH_SUPPLIED_BY]->(sp:SupplierPlant)
    COLUMNS (
      wc.vin AS vin,
      wc.claim_id AS claim_id,
      wc.claim_amount AS claim_amount,
      pt.part_name AS part_name,
      b.subcomponent_lot_id AS batch_lot_id,
      sp.plant_name AS supplier_plant
    )
  )
  GROUP BY vin, claim_id, part_name
)
SELECT
  s.component AS defective_part,
  s.ota_campaign,
  s.firmware,
  s.dtc_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.claim_id) AS avoidable_approved_claims,
  MAX(h.linked_safety_batches) AS safety_batches_traced,
  MAX(h.linked_supplier_plants) AS upstream_supplier_plants,
  ROUND(SUM(h.claim_amount), 2) AS avoidable_hardware_leakage_usd
FROM spoke_unpatched_ota_vins s
INNER JOIN hub_deduped_warranty_claims h
  ON s.vin = h.vin AND s.component = h.part_name
GROUP BY defective_part, ota_campaign, firmware, dtc_code
ORDER BY avoidable_hardware_leakage_usd DESC
LIMIT 5;

verified_queries.naturalLanguageQuestion: What is our total avoidable OTA hardware replacement leakage across the connected vehicle fleet?
verified_queries.sqlQuery:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS correlated_approved_claims,
  COUNTIF(is_avoidable_ota_hardware_claim) AS avoidable_ota_hardware_claims,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(is_avoidable_ota_hardware_claim, claim_amount, 0)), 2) AS avoidable_ota_hardware_leakage_usd
FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.v_cross_project_ota_warranty_leakage`;
